issues.quote: $72.4 billion against $61.3 billion works out to about 0.4%.
issues.problem: The note gives the wrong comparison figure. Fiscal 2022 net income was $72.7B, not $61.3B. $72.4B vs. $72.7B is about a 0.4% decline on rounded figures. The unrounded figures ($72,361M vs. $72,738M) give about 0.52%, which matches the stated 0.5%.

data.summary: The main figures (revenue, net income, operating cash flow, cash, total assets, total liabilities, and the growth rates) match Microsoft's reported FY2023 and FY2022 results. The only error is in the note, which uses $61.3B instead of the correct prior-year net income of $72.7B.
